chunks: Ali narrated from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام: concerning

A man gouged out the eye of a woman, so he said: “If they wish, they may gouge out his eye and pay to him one-quarter of the diyah; and if she wishes, she may take one-quarter of the diyah.” And he said: “Concerning a woman who gouged out the eye of a man: if he wishes, he may gouge out her eye; otherwise, he takes the diyah of his eye.”

key_terms.دِيَةَ عَيْنِهِ: the compensation due for his eye
key_terms.رُبُعَ الدِّيَةِ: one-quarter of the full diyah as compensation in this ruling
key_terms.عَيْنَ: the eye as the injured limb
key_terms.فَقَأَ: gouged out or put out an eye

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man gouges out a woman's eye or a woman gouges out a man's eye in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding qisas and diyah in cases of eye injury between a man and a woman. It explains the available legal options when retaliation is sought, taking into account the difference in diyah between the parties.
